definition: For a fixed Ontic roster and total predicate P:World→Being→Prop, ActualistAll m P w means every candidate x satisfying ExistsAt w x satisfies P w x. Only the quantifier is existence-guarded; P remains defined on absent candidates.
note: Approved source-free semantic interface for fixed-roster actualist domain transfer. No physical or metaphysical domain policy is asserted. No free-logic proof calculus, counterpart semantics, or general quantified syntax is introduced.
